Rank Test (Corrado 1989)

Source: R/multi_event_test_statistics.R
RankTest.Rd

Non-parametric rank test for event studies. Ranks abnormal returns across the combined estimation and event windows, which is robust to non-normality of abnormal returns.

See also

Other eventstudy-statistics: ARTTest, BHARTTest, BMPTest, CARTTest, CSectTTest, CalendarTimePortfolioTest, GeneralizedSignTest, KolariPynnonenTest, MultiEventStatisticsSet, PatellZTest, SignTest, SingleEventStatisticsSet, StatisticsSetBase, adjust_p_values(), bootstrap_test(), car_by_group(), car_quantiles(), cross_sectional_regression(), model_diagnostics(), pretrend_test(), simulate_event_study(), validate_task()
